about: Skills whose HD picture is Median's own classic animation, played as a particle flipbook (tools/effects_classic.py, docs/hd-effects-classic.md). `enabled` false: the build makes none of it and the rows keep their stand-in effects.

bioneticstar.why: Bionetic Slam leaves 16 of these at once; their HD picture is tuned for that pile. The shared row teethexplodeblue keeps its effect for every other missile.

legiontile.name: mxl_fx_legiontile
legiontile.shared: Phalanx's archers (bug #570): every skill and monster that makes legionmaker, and so legiontile (Phalanx New, Phalanx, Mon Bowless Phalanx), draws the same golden archer in legacy, so HD gets it for all of them.
legiontile.opaque: The archer is opaque in legacy (Trans 0). In HD it is three additive colour layers that add up to the picture, so it reads as a bright golden spirit archer; the dark armour shows less than in legacy.

barb_1.name: mxl_fx_barb_1
barb_1.shared: The Barbarian stances' feathers (bug #578): every state that shows barb_1 draws Median's vdfeathers round the unit in legacy, so HD gets them for all of them.
barb_1.opaque: Classic draws the dark feathers with Trans 5 (the normal draw); the HD flipbook is alpha-blended (`blend` alpha), so they stay dark as in classic, with a faint yellow tint of the stance's light.
